Third-party files the companion app serves itself, so it works without the internet.

- `chart.umd.min.js`: Chart.js 4.4.1 (MIT), from https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/Chart.js/4.4.1/chart.umd.min.js
- `../fonts/geologica-*.woff2`: Geologica variable font (SIL Open Font License, see `../fonts/OFL-Geologica.txt`), from Google Fonts
- Platform glyphs in `app.js` (Twitch, Kick, YouTube, Telegram, Claude): Simple Icons 15.22.0 (CC0)
